title: Man Allegedly Used AI-Altered Gun Photograph to Threaten Former Partner in Santa Helena de Goiás, Brazil
summary: A man allegedly used an AI-altered photograph of himself holding a pistol to threaten his former partner and her father in Santa Helena de Goiás, Brazil. Police reportedly arrested him in nearby Rio Verde after the woman sought help. He reportedly said he used AI to simulate a weapon; a local report said police had not confirmed his explanation. Searches reportedly found no firearm.
